title: Organ Systems Working Together
seo_title: JSS 2 Intermediate Science: Organ Systems Working Together Worksheets (NERDC)
standard_code: JSS 2 Intermediate Science: Living and Non-Living Things
standard_text: The digestive, respiratory and circulatory systems work together to supply cells with nutrients and oxygen and remove wastes; keeping these systems healthy. (summary of the Intermediate Science curriculum, JSS 2, theme: Living and Non-Living Things)
meta_desc: Free JSS 2 Intermediate Science worksheets (NERDC curriculum, theme: Living and Non-Living Things): the respiratory system, the circulatory system, gas exchange, the digestive system and digestion and enzymes. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The heart pumps blood; the lungs exchange gases.
key_sub: Food is digested and absorbed in the small intestine.
body_html:
How to think about it

The heart pumps blood through arteries (away from the heart), capillaries and veins (back to the heart). Blood carries oxygen, food and wastes. In the lungs, oxygen diffuses from the alveoli into the blood and carbon dioxide diffuses out.

Digestion breaks food down: the mouth (teeth and saliva), oesophagus, stomach (acid and enzymes), small intestine (digestion and absorption through villi) and large intestine (water is absorbed). Enzymes speed up digestion.

Example

Which blood vessels carry blood away from the heart?

A for away

Answer: arteries

Example

Where are most nutrients absorbed?

A long tube with villi

Answer: the small intestine

Common mistakes

  • Thinking the lungs pump blood.
  • Thinking food is absorbed in the stomach.
  • Thinking veins carry only oxygen-poor blood (the pulmonary vein does not).

faq.q: Why does your breathing get faster when you exercise?
faq.a: Your muscles need more oxygen and produce more carbon dioxide.

faq.q: Why do the alveoli have thin walls?
faq.a: So that gases can diffuse across them quickly.

items.q: What is the job of the intercostal muscles?

Two tubes that carry air from the trachea into each lung.
Tiny hairs on cells lining the airways that sweep mucus and dirt up and away from the lungs.
Bones that protect the lungs and heart.
items.e: Each part has a job.
